title: Reinforce
text: Place up to 3 available Soldiers into your Trench reinforcement area.
reminder: Reinforcement-area limit: 5 Soldiers. Does not place Soldiers directly into battlefield zones.

title: Patrol
text: Choose up to 2 Soldiers in one battlefield zone. Move them 1 zone forward or backward without spending Boots.
reminder: Cannot move Soldiers from the Trench reinforcement area. Moved Soldiers arrive exposed.

title: General's Order
text: After Roll 1 but before Initiative is determined, choose one: reroll up to 2 of your Action Dice; OR change 1 Action Die to match a non-Wild symbol naturally showing in Roll 1.
reminder: No Whistle required. Resolve on Roll 1 before Initiative. Wilds are ignored for Initiative. After Initiative is fixed, the normal 2 post-Initiative Action-dice rerolls remain available, and dice affected by General's Order may be rerolled.

title: Charge
text: Choose up to 3 Soldiers in one battlefield zone. Move them 1 zone forward without spending Boots.
reminder: Destination may be friendly-controlled, Contested, or enemy-controlled. Soldiers arrive exposed and may attack normally later.

title: Bayonet Charge
text: Choose up to 3 Soldiers in one friendly-controlled zone adjacent to an enemy-controlled zone. Move them into that zone, then immediately attack with those Soldiers. Reroll all misses once.
reminder: No Boots. They cannot enter Cover as part of the charge. Participating Soldiers cannot attack again this turn.

title: Bogged Down
text: Enemy Tanks cannot move for the remainder of this round.
reminder: Not retroactive. Tanks may still attack or Overrun if otherwise eligible.

title: Bombing Run
text: Choose 1 battlefield zone. Roll 1 Attack Die for each enemy Soldier in that zone and allocate the Hits among enemy Soldiers there.
reminder: Cover protects normally. Machine Guns, Mortars, and Tanks are unaffected.

title: Carrier Pigeon
text: Draw 1 Mission Card.
reminder: May be played at 5 Missions. After resolving, if above 5, discard chosen Missions to the bottom of the Mission deck until you hold 5.

title: Cavalry Charge
text: For the remainder of this round, your Soldiers may move through enemy-controlled zones. Whenever one or more of your Soldiers make an attack this round, add 1 Attack Die to that attack.
reminder: +1 die per attack, not per Soldier. Applies to Combined Fire only if at least 1 Soldier participates.

title: Christmas Truce
text: For the remainder of this round, neither player may make attacks or resolve any Event or Shock effect that directly causes enemy casualties, Damage, Cover destruction, or forced Retreat.
reminder: Not retroactive. Movement, deployment, repair, Cover actions, reinforcement, reconnaissance, and other non-hostile effects remain legal.

title: Entrench
text: Move up to 3 Soldiers from your Trench reinforcement area directly into available Cover Positions in any battlefield zone you control.
reminder: No Boots or Shovels required. Normal Cover capacity applies.

title: Espionage
text: Randomly take 1 Event Card from your opponent's hand. Either play it immediately, if its timing allows, or add it to your hand.
reminder: 7-card Event hand limit applies. If already at 7, the stolen card may only be played immediately if legal.

title: Field Hospital
text: Return up to 3 Soldiers eliminated this round to your Trench reinforcement area.
reminder: Only current-round casualties are eligible. Reinforcement-area limit: 5 Soldiers.

title: Field Repairs
text: Choose 1 friendly Machine Gun, Mortar, or Tank. Remove 1 Damage from a Machine Gun or Mortar, or up to 2 Damage from a Tank.
reminder: Repairs one chosen Unit only; repair cannot be split across multiple Units.

title: Heavy Barrage
text: Choose 1 enemy-controlled battlefield zone. Generate 3 Hits in that zone and allocate them among eligible enemy targets.
reminder: Tanks cannot be targeted. Normal Cover, Damage, destruction, and excess-Hit rules apply. No Mortar is required.

title: Mobility
text: Choose 1 undamaged Mortar. That Mortar may move and attack this round.
reminder: Movement still costs Boots. The attack still uses the Mortar Die.

title: Precision Barrage
text: Choose 1 undamaged Mortar. For that Mortar's attack this round, choose the targeted battlefield zone instead of rolling the Mortar Die.
reminder: Attack still generates the normal 2 Hits and cannot target Tanks.

title: Raid
text: Choose up to 2 Soldiers in one friendly-controlled battlefield zone. Move them 1 zone forward without spending Boots. If the destination contains available Cover, they may immediately enter that Cover without spending Shovels.
reminder: Destination need not be friendly-controlled. Normal Cover capacity applies. Soldiers may still attack later if eligible.

title: Recon Flight
text: Choose 1 battlefield zone. Reveal all unrevealed Cover Positions in that zone.
reminder: Revealed Cover remains revealed. Does not reveal Mission or Event Cards.

title: Sabotage
text: Choose 1 unused enemy Action Die. Take that die and use it as though it were one of your own Action Dice for the remainder of this round.
reminder: Keep its current face. A stolen Wild follows your Wild rules. It cannot contribute to this turn's Shock Option. Return it at end of round.

title: Scout
text: Choose 1 enemy-occupied Cover Position in a zone containing or adjacent to one of your Soldiers. Reveal that Cover if unrevealed. Then choose 1 Soldier in that Cover; that Soldier leaves Cover and becomes exposed in the same zone.
reminder: Does not force Retreat.

title: Smoke Screen
text: Choose 1 battlefield zone. For the remainder of the round, direct-fire attacks cannot be made into or out of that zone from another zone.
reminder: Same-zone attacks and Tank Overrun remain legal. Mortars and indirect hostile Event effects are unaffected unless stated otherwise.

title: Sniper
text: Choose 1 enemy Soldier in any battlefield zone. Roll 2 Attack Dice. If at least 1 Hit is rolled, eliminate that Soldier.
reminder: Ignore Cover Defense. Extra Hits are lost. Cannot target Machine Guns, Mortars, or Tanks.

title: Spotter
text: Choose 1 undamaged Mortar. When that Mortar attacks this round, roll the Mortar Die twice and choose either result.
reminder: Blanks may still occur. Attack still generates the normal 2 Hits and cannot target Tanks.

title: Suppression
text: Choose either Machine Guns or Mortars. All enemy Units of the chosen type cannot attack for the remainder of this round.
reminder: Suppressed Machine Guns cannot join Combined Fire. Suppressed Mortars may still move if otherwise eligible. No Control reduction.

title: Trench Fever
text: Choose 1 battlefield zone. Eliminate up to 2 exposed enemy Soldiers in that zone.
reminder: Soldiers in Cover are unaffected. No attack roll is required.

title: Trench Foot
text: Enemy Soldiers cannot move for the remainder of this round.
reminder: No Boot or movement-Event movement. Forced Retreat remains legal. Soldiers may still Leave Cover or Dig In if they do not then move zones.

title: Armored Advance
text: Choose 1 Tank. Immediately move that Tank 1 zone forward. This move is additional to its normal Tank Movement this round.
reminder: Normal Tank movement restrictions apply. If it enters the opponent's Trench from enemy Zone 1, score 1 VP, remove the Tank, and return it to available supply.

title: Tunnel
text: Move up to 2 Soldiers from your Trench reinforcement area directly into one battlefield zone you control. Those Soldiers cannot attack this round.
reminder: Soldiers arrive exposed and do not automatically enter Cover.
